title: Number wall pops when notifications arrive
symptom: After disabling the 'Number wall on lock screen' option, the number wall still pops up with a black background when the phone is locked and a new notification arrives, waking the phone for a few seconds. Changing wallpapers did not help.
cause: The issue was caused by xDrip being enabled in Android accessibility settings for Always On Display.
fix: Disable 'Use xDrip+' under the menu Accessibility > xDrip+.
evidence_quote: I disabled "Use xDrip+" under the menu Accessibility > xDrip+ and the problem seems to be solved!
